name: Eye of the Storm

parts.label: Passive
parts.text: Passive: Whenever Janna's abilities slow or knock up at least one enemy champion, 20% of Eye of the Storm's cooldown is refunded. This may occur once per spell cast.

mechanics.evidence: Passive: Whenever Janna's abilities slow or knock up at least one enemy champion, 20% of Eye of the Storm's cooldown is refunded.
Passive: Whenever Janna's abilities slow or knock up at least one enemy champion, 20% of Eye of the Storm's cooldown is refunded.

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Janna grants the target allied champion or turret, or herself, a shield for 4 seconds.

mechanics.evidence: Active: Janna grants the target allied champion or turret, or herself, a shield for 4 seconds.

parts.text: While the shield holds, the target gains bonus attack damage.

notes: Eye of the Storm has a forgiveness radius of 175 units.
Janna receives kill credit on enemy champions that are killed by turrets shielded by Eye of the Storm.
Allied turrets will benefit from the bonus attack damage when targeted by Eye of the Storm.

name: Tailwind

name: Howling Gale

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Janna summons a whirlwind at her current location that charges up over 3 seconds, increasing its range, speed, damage, and knock up duration every second over the duration. Howling Gale's direction is determined by this cast.

mechanics.evidence: Active: Janna summons a whirlwind at her current location that charges up over 3 seconds, increasing its range, speed, damage, and knock up duration every second over the duration.

parts.text: Howling Gale can be recast at any time within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration.

parts.label: Recast
parts.text: Recast: Janna launches the whirlwind in the direction she targeted over 1.25 seconds, dealing magic damage to enemies hit and knocking them up for 0.5 / 0.55 / 0.6 / 0.65 / 0.7 / 0.75 / 0.8 / 0.85 / 0.9 / 0.95 / 1 / 1.05 / 1.1 / 1.15 / 1.2 / 1.25 (based on seconds charged) seconds.

name: Zephyr

parts.label: Passive
parts.text: Passive: Janna is ghosted and gains bonus movement speed.

mechanics.evidence: Passive: Janna is ghosted and gains bonus movement speed.

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Janna sends an air elemental at the target enemy that deals magic damage and slows them for 2 seconds, capped at 99%.

mechanics.evidence: Active: Janna sends an air elemental at the target enemy that deals magic damage and slows them for 2 seconds, capped at 99%.

notes: The maximum slow (99%) is reached with 1316.66666667 / 1250 / 1183.33333333 / 1116.66666667 / 1050 ability power.
If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
